shippingAndPayments.title: Shipping and payments
shippingAndPayments.description: How we deliver orders, what the delivery cost depends on and how you can pay.
shippingAndPayments.heading: Shipping and payments
shippingAndPayments.lead: Everything worth knowing before you pay: delivery methods, costs and ways to pay.

delivery.heading: Delivery methods
delivery.intro: You choose the delivery method while placing your order, in the “Delivery” step.

methods.1: InPost Parcel Locker: pick a locker on the map and collect your parcel whenever it suits you.
methods.2: Courier: the parcel goes to the address given in the order.

delivery.checkout: The delivery step shows the methods available for your country together with their price, before you go on to payment.

cost.heading: Delivery cost

rules.2: Below that amount, you see the delivery price in the order summary before you pay.

cost.prices: The price list of each delivery method will be added soon.

time.heading: Delivery time
time.dispatch: We show the dispatch time on every product, next to the “Add to cart” button.
time.carriers: How long each carrier takes to deliver will be added soon.

payments.heading: Payments
payments.intro: You pay in the last step of your order. Payments are handled by the payment provider Stripe.

methods.1: Card: enter the card number, expiry date and CVC. Your bank may ask you to confirm the payment.
methods.2: BLIK: enter the six-digit code from your banking app and confirm the payment in the app. BLIK works for payments in Polish złoty.
methods.3: Przelewy24: you go to your bank's page, approve the transfer and come back to the store.

payments.security: We don't store your card details: you enter them in the payment provider's secure field.

vat.heading: Prices and VAT
vat.prices: Prices are shown in your region's currency. Taxes are listed separately in the cart and order summary; how much they are depends on the delivery country.
vat.invoice: Information about VAT invoices will be added soon.

returns.title: Returns and complaints
returns.description: How to return a product within the statutory period and how to make a complaint.
returns.heading: Returns and complaints
returns.lead: A return is your decision, a complaint is our responsibility. We describe each one separately, step by step.

withdrawal.heading: Returns: withdrawing from the contract
withdrawal.right: When you buy online, you may withdraw from the contract without giving a reason within 14 days of the day you received the parcel.
withdrawal.period: Whether a longer return period applies in our store will be added soon.

steps.heading: How to return a product

items.1: Before the period ends, tell us that you are withdrawing from the contract: write to us and include the order number.
items.2: Pack the products so that they don't get damaged on the way, and include the order number.
items.3: Send the parcel back no later than 14 days after the day you told us.
items.4: Once we receive the products, we refund you as described below.

steps.address: The return address will be added soon.
steps.cost: Who pays for sending the parcel back will be added soon.

rules.1: We refund you with the payment method you used, unless we agree otherwise.
rules.2: We refund you within 14 days of receiving your notice of withdrawal. We may withhold the refund until we have received the products or proof that you sent them back.
rules.3: We also refund the cost of delivery to you, up to the cheapest standard delivery method offered by the store.

complaints.heading: Complaints
complaints.liability: We are responsible for the product being in conformity with the contract. If a defect shows within two years of delivery, you can make a complaint.

steps.1: Write to us: include the order number, describe the problem and, if you can, add photos.
steps.2: Tell us what you would like: a repair or a replacement, or, where that isn't possible, a price reduction or withdrawal from the contract.
steps.3: If we ask you to send the product, we'll tell you how.

complaints.answer: We respond to a complaint within 14 days.
complaints.address: Where to send a product under complaint and who pays for the shipping will be added soon.

sizeGuide.title: Size guide
sizeGuide.description: Body measurements for our sizes and how to measure yourself.
sizeGuide.heading: Size guide
sizeGuide.lead: Two minutes with a tape measure can save you a return. Measure yourself and compare with the table.

table.heading: Measurements
table.intro: Compare your measurements with the table and choose the size that fits all three.
table.source: Measurements for individual collections will be added to the table.

measure.heading: How to measure
measure.intro: Measure yourself in underwear, with the tape close to the body but not tight. It's easiest with someone's help.

points.1: Chest: around the fullest part, with the tape level under the arms.
points.2: Waist: around the narrowest part of the torso, usually a few centimetres above the navel.
points.3: Hips: around the widest part, with your feet together.

measure.between: Each product page has a note on the fit. If you are between two sizes, choose the larger one for a close fit.

trackOrder.title: Track your order
trackOrder.description: Where to find the tracking number and how to check on your order.
trackOrder.heading: Where is my parcel?
trackOrder.lead: You check the parcel's status with the carrier. Here's where the tracking link comes from and what to do if you don't have it.

steps.1: After you place an order, we send an e-mail confirming it, with the order number.
steps.2: When we hand the parcel to the carrier, the carrier sends you an e-mail with the tracking number and a tracking link.
steps.3: For delivery to an InPost Parcel Locker, the carrier also lets you know when the parcel is ready for collection.

account.heading: Have an account?
account.intro: We send order messages to the e-mail address given in the order. After signing in, the account page shows which address belongs to your account.

checks.1: Look in the spam and promotions folders of your mailbox.
checks.2: Check that the e-mail address in the order confirmation is correct. If it isn't, write to us with the order number.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.description: Answers to questions about orders, delivery, payments, returns, sizes, care and your account.
faq.heading: Frequently asked questions
faq.lead: Short answers to what you ask us most often. The other help pages have the details.

place.q: How do I place an order?
place.a: Add products to the cart and go to checkout. Enter your address, choose a delivery method and pay. We'll send the order confirmation by e-mail.

change.q: Can I change or cancel my order?
change.a: Write to us as soon as possible with the order number and we'll check whether the parcel has left yet. After delivery, you can use your right to return it.

methods.q: How can I receive my order?
methods.a: At an InPost Parcel Locker or by courier to your address. The delivery step shows the methods and prices for your country; the “Shipping and payments” page tells you more.

track.q: How do I find out where my parcel is?
track.a: Once we ship your order, the carrier e-mails you the tracking number and a tracking link. More on the “Track your order” page.

methods.a: By card, with BLIK or through Przelewy24. You choose the method in the last step of your order.

how.q: How do I return a product?
how.a: You have 14 days from receiving the parcel to withdraw from the contract without giving a reason. Tell us and send the products back; the “Returns and complaints” page has the steps.

refund.q: When will I get my money back?
refund.a: Within 14 days of receiving your notice of withdrawal, with the method you paid with. We may withhold the refund until we have received the products or proof that you sent them back.

choose.q: How do I choose my size?
choose.a: Measure your chest, waist and hips and compare them with the size guide. You can also open the table on every product, next to the size picker.

wash.q: How should I wash and store my clothes?
wash.a: Always start with the care label. General advice for wool, cotton, linen and silk is on the “Materials and care” page.

needed.a: No. You can order without an account by giving your e-mail address while placing the order.

create.q: How do I create an account?
create.a: Go to the account page, choose to register, enter your details and set a password.
